work.author: 14.6 ACTA GREGORII PP. XVI.
work.description: Italian chirograph CXLI (no candidate heading was detected) to Cardinal Agostino Rivarola, prefect of the Congregazione delle Acque, ordering the Aniene diversion at Tivoli; address 22627–22630, body 22633–22881, Dato 22883–22885. Excluded: provenance citation, signature line, the second half of the running title and page number 145 (22683–22692); signature 19 and page-164 running title (22762–22765); provenance citation 22830. The Dato at 22883–22885 reads questo di g giugno 1832; the recognized day glyph g is not normalized, so the act date is left unknown (June 1832). Issuer evidence 14.6 ACTA GREGORII PP. XVI. at LF22765 (running-title context; see source_attribution_context). Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
